page.layout: One printed page. Full-width running head at top with page number at left. Then a verse block in italic, centred. Then centred title headings (division title, De, Deo Providente, per Conservationem, Summarium). Then a justified paragraph of summary text in italic and roman, ending with a catchword-like hyphenated word "latio" at the right below the last line.

l.i: Quo Tibi tam potuit soboles humana placere,
Ut res dilectas inter & ante loces!
Das etenim facili dominetur in omnia nutu,
Mille greges pecudum, genus omne volatile
coeli, Squammigerum quicquid per mare sulcat aquas.
O Domine! O magni Fabricator maxime Mundi,
Quam celebre est totonomen in orbe Tuum!
